admissionPolicy.rule: A face is ADMITTED only when every required gate in its family contract is PROVEN and an explicit governed Target Profile binding exists.
admissionPolicy.inheritanceRule: A proven family geometry, aim reference, procedure, mechanical branch, or confirmation fact is evaluated once and inherited by every traceably conforming face; publisher/product/face/representation identity never changes.
admissionPolicy.antiRedundancyRule: Publisher, SKU, color, logo, paper, branding, and non-operative wording differences never trigger re-governance of a family fact. Only the exact representation-to-family conformance and registration facts remain product-specific.
admissionPolicy.registrationRule: Registration and orientation proof are exact-representation facts and are never inherited from a different publisher face.
admissionPolicy.equipmentRule: Mechanical authority is inherited from the governed family only for an explicitly proven applicable equipment branch; unrelated marketing claims are ignored.
admissionPolicy.failureRule: Any unresolved required gate produces HOLD with exact missing facts. Candidate family assignment, visual similarity, or shared branding cannot create a runtime binding.

requiredGates.name: Physical geometry and pitch
requiredGates.proofRule: Prove an 18 x 20 uniform grid at 0.96 cm physical pitch and the governed grid-to-sheet relationship from primary dimensional evidence or a traceable issued-form identity.

requiredGates.name: Aim reference
requiredGates.proofRule: Prove the center crosshairs/white-dot aim at 9 columns and 10 rows from the grid origin.

requiredGates.name: Exact representation and landmarks
requiredGates.proofRule: Preserve an exact face/side representation and enumerate asymmetric identity/orientation landmarks without substituting another publisher's artwork.

requiredGates.name: Standard M16A2/A3 procedure
requiredGates.proofRule: Prove the face is for the 25-meter M16A2/A3 to 300-meter procedure; the governed family supplies setup, finalization, and confirmation details once.

requiredGates.name: Applicable governed mechanical branch
requiredGates.proofRule: Prove M16A2 standard iron applicability, then bind the existing governed M16A2 mechanical authority. M16A4/M4 claims do not inherit this branch.

requiredGates.name: Exact-face registration and orientation
requiredGates.proofRule: Build and verify an exact-face Target Image Registration package with TOP/BOTTOM/LEFT/RIGHT proof and source-evidence reconciliation.
